title: Drive the motor forwards
story: An H-bridge has four switches around a small DC motor. At the moment of starting, the motor is not yet turning, so it behaves like its 4 ohm winding. The battery reaches the bridge through 0.1 ohm of wiring. Close and open the four switches so current flows through the motor from A to B (forwards) with at least 2 A, without ever shorting the battery: the wiring must carry no more than 5 A.

goals.label: at least 2 A through the motor from A to B
battery wiring carries at most 5 A (no short circuit)

hints: For current to go from A to B, A must connect to the battery's plus and B to ground.
Never close both switches on the same side (S1 and S2, or S3 and S4): that shorts the battery.
